title: Venmo: Making Payments Social
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Venmo: Making Payments Social.

hook.text: Venmo turned paying friends into a social experience with a public feed of transactions.

buildup.text: Splitting dinner or paying rent became as easy as sending a text message.

discovery.text: The social feed with emojis and notes made money transfers feel fun instead of formal.

twist.text: The public feed accidentally revealed affairs, drug deals, and spending habits to anyone who looked.

climax.text: Venmo proved that even boring financial tools can win by adding a social layer.

punchline.text: Paying friends became a social media post.

quiz.question: What made Venmo different from traditional payments?
options: A social feed that showed transactions publicly
